_comment: Everything the dashboard's Apply kit lets you copy. Edit any value, save, and refresh the dashboard (no restart needed). Lines starting with EDIT ME are placeholders: replace them with your real answer. This repo is public, so your phone number and salary are left out on purpose: keep real numbers in a private copy.

answers.label: Where are you based?
answers.value: Abuja, Nigeria (WAT, UTC+1, the same working hours as Central Europe). I work remotely.

answers.label: Work authorization / how you work
answers.value: I am a Nigerian citizen living in Nigeria, with the right to work here. For foreign companies I can work as an independent contractor (B2B) or through an employer of record such as Deel or Remote, and invoice through Wise, Payoneer or Deel.

answers.label: Salary expectation
answers.value: EDIT ME: your monthly figure in USD

answers.label: Years of experience
answers.value: 4 years building production web and mobile products with TypeScript, Next.js, React, Vue/Nuxt, Node.js and Laravel.

answers.label: Full-time or contract?
answers.value: Open to both full-time and long-term contract roles.

answers.label: Why this stack?
answers.value: I work in React/Next.js and Vue 3/Nuxt 3 daily, and build the backends too (Node.js, NestJS, Express, Laravel, PostgreSQL, Redis, BullMQ). I can own a feature from database to UI.

summaries.frontend_engineer: Frontend-focused software engineer with 4 years of experience building web and mobile products, including a savings and loans fintech app, admin dashboards and data-heavy internal tools. Builds in Vue 3 and Nuxt 3 with the Composition API, and in React and Next.js. Built a Next.js and Redux dashboard serving 100,000+ users, and real-time calls and chat with Socket.IO and MediaSoup.
summaries.react_native: Frontend and mobile engineer with 4 years of experience, including React Native and Expo work on Adashe, a savings, loans and contributions app for 3,000+ users, a payroll and HR platform shipped on web and mobile, and an event invitation app with real-time RSVPs and notifications.
summaries.product_engineer: Full-stack software engineer with 4 years of experience shipping products end to end: Next.js, React and Vue/Nuxt on the frontend, Node.js, NestJS, Express and Laravel on the backend, with PostgreSQL, Prisma, Drizzle, Redis and BullMQ. Built Anissa, a project-management platform with background automations and granular permissions, and Cally, a scheduling platform with calendar sync and double-booking protection.
